metadata.name: WordPress Core Execution Tests - Roles and Capabilities
metadata.description: Code generation tasks for WordPress Roles and Capabilities APIs

tests.prompt: Implement a function that registers a role named wpbp_manager with the read and wpbp_manage capabilities, then reports whether WordPress can retrieve that role with the custom capability.
tests.expected_behavior: Reviewer contract: The function should use the roles API to register wpbp_manager and verify the role through WordPress role helpers. The runtime checks call the function, inspect the registered role, and remove it during teardown.
requirements: Use WordPress roles/capabilities APIs
Verify the role through WordPress helpers

required_patterns.description: Registers a role through the WordPress API
Retrieves the role through the WordPress API
Checks the role capability through a helper

assertions.code: if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_roles_caps_001' ) ) { return false; } $returned = wpbp_roles_caps_001(); $role = get_role( 'wpbp_manager' ); return (bool) $returned && $role instanceof WP_Role && $role->has_cap( 'read' ) && $role->has_cap( 'wpbp_manage' );
assertions.description: wpbp_manager is registered with the requested capabilities

tests.reference_solution: function wpbp_roles_caps_001(): bool { add_role( 'wpbp_manager', 'WPBP Manager', array( 'read' => true, 'wpbp_manage' => true ) ); $role = get_role( 'wpbp_manager' ); return $role instanceof WP_Role && $role->has_cap( 'read' ) && $role->has_cap( 'wpbp_manage' ); }

tests.prompt: Implement a function that adds wpbp_temp_cap to the Subscriber role, verifies the role has it, removes it again, and reports whether both transitions succeeded.
tests.expected_behavior: Reviewer contract: The function should mutate the Subscriber role through WP_Role methods and leave the temporary capability removed. The runtime spies on `updated_option` for the roles option to observe `wpbp_temp_cap` actually being added during the call, so a hard-coded `return true` fails, and checks the final Subscriber role state.
requirements: Use WordPress roles/capabilities APIs
Leave the Subscriber role without the temporary capability

required_patterns.description: Retrieves the Subscriber role through the WordPress API
Adds a capability through the role API
Removes the temporary capability through the role API
Verifies capability state through a helper

assertions.code: if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_roles_caps_002' ) ) { return false; } $saw_cap_added = false; $spy = function ( $option, $old_value, $value ) use ( &$saw_cap_added ) { if ( false !== strpos( (string) $option, 'user_roles' ) && is_array( $value ) && ! empty( $value['subscriber']['capabilities']['wpbp_temp_cap'] ) ) { $saw_cap_added = true; } }; add_action( 'updated_option', $spy, 10, 3 ); $ok = wpbp_roles_caps_002(); remove_action( 'updated_option', $spy, 10 ); $role = get_role( 'subscriber' ); return true === $ok && $saw_cap_added && $role instanceof WP_Role && ! $role->has_cap( 'wpbp_temp_cap' );
assertions.description: The temporary capability is observed being added to the Subscriber role and is removed afterward

tests.reference_solution: function wpbp_roles_caps_002(): bool { $role = get_role( 'subscriber' ); if ( ! $role instanceof WP_Role ) { return false; } $role->add_cap( 'wpbp_temp_cap' ); $had_cap = $role->has_cap( 'wpbp_temp_cap' ); $role->remove_cap( 'wpbp_temp_cap' ); return $had_cap && ! $role->has_cap( 'wpbp_temp_cap' ); }

tests.prompt: Implement a function that switches to the given user and reports whether the current user can perform the requested capability.
tests.expected_behavior: Reviewer contract: The function should set the current user to the supplied user ID and delegate the capability check to WordPress. The runtime uses a Subscriber fixture to verify a granted capability and a denied capability, then deletes the user and resets the current user.
requirements: Use WordPress roles/capabilities APIs
Check the capability as the current user after switching

assertions.code: $user_id = $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_003_user_id'] ?? 0; if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_roles_caps_003' ) || ! is_int( $user_id ) ) { return false; } return wpbp_roles_caps_003( $user_id, 'read' ) && ! wpbp_roles_caps_003( $user_id, 'manage_options' );
assertions.description: A switched Subscriber can read but cannot manage options

runtime_checks.teardown: $user_id = $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_003_user_id'] ?? 0; if ( is_int( $user_id ) ) { require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/user.php'; wp_delete_user( $user_id ); } wp_set_current_user( 0 ); unset( $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_003_user_id'] );

tests.reference_solution: function wpbp_roles_caps_003( int $user_id, string $cap ): bool { wp_set_current_user( $user_id ); return current_user_can( $cap ); }

tests.prompt: Implement a function that returns the primitive capabilities WordPress requires for the given user to edit the given post.
tests.expected_behavior: Reviewer contract: The function should use WordPress meta-cap mapping for edit_post. The runtime creates an Author-owned draft post and expects WordPress to map the edit request to edit_posts, then removes the post and user.
requirements: Use WordPress roles/capabilities APIs
Return the primitive capabilities from WordPress meta-cap mapping

runtime_checks.setup: $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_004_user_id'] = wp_insert_user( array( 'user_login' => 'wpbp_meta_cap_' . wp_rand(), 'user_pass' => wp_generate_password(), 'role' => 'author' ) ); if ( is_int( $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_004_user_id'] ) ) { $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_004_post_id'] = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_title' => 'WPBP owned draft', 'post_status' => 'draft', 'post_author' => $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_004_user_id'] ) ); }

assertions.code: $user_id = $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_004_user_id'] ?? 0; $post_id = $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_004_post_id'] ?? 0; if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_roles_caps_004' ) || ! is_int( $user_id ) || ! is_int( $post_id ) ) { return false; } $caps = wpbp_roles_caps_004( $user_id, $post_id ); return is_array( $caps ) && array_values( $caps ) === array( 'edit_posts' );
assertions.description: Editing an Author-owned draft maps to edit_posts

runtime_checks.teardown: $post_id = $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_004_post_id'] ?? 0; if ( is_int( $post_id ) ) { wp_delete_post( $post_id, true ); } $user_id = $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_004_user_id'] ?? 0; if ( is_int( $user_id ) ) { require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/user.php'; wp_delete_user( $user_id ); } unset( $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_004_post_id'], $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_004_user_id'] );

tests.reference_solution: function wpbp_roles_caps_004( int $user_id, int $post_id ): array { return map_meta_cap( 'edit_post', $user_id, $post_id ); }

tests.prompt: Implement a function that grants the capability directly to the given user and returns whether WordPress recognizes the grant.
tests.expected_behavior: Reviewer contract: The function should add a direct user capability through WP_User and verify it with WordPress capability checks. The runtime confirms both the return value and the user's observable capability before deleting the fixture user.
requirements: Use the WP_User capability API
Verify the grant with WordPress capability checks

required_patterns.description: Verifies the user capability through WordPress

assertions.code: $user_id = $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_005_user_id'] ?? 0; if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_roles_caps_005' ) || ! is_int( $user_id ) ) { return false; } $ok = wpbp_roles_caps_005( $user_id, 'wpbp_direct' ); return (bool) $ok && user_can( $user_id, 'wpbp_direct' );
assertions.description: The direct user capability is granted and recognized

runtime_checks.teardown: $user_id = $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_005_user_id'] ?? 0; if ( is_int( $user_id ) ) { require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/user.php'; wp_delete_user( $user_id ); } unset( $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_005_user_id'] );

tests.reference_solution: function wpbp_roles_caps_005( int $user_id, string $cap ): bool { $user = new WP_User( $user_id ); $user->add_cap( $cap ); return user_can( $user_id, $cap ); }

tests.prompt: Implement a function that allows Editor in the default new-user role dropdown while Administrator remains excluded.
tests.expected_behavior: Reviewer contract: The function should register a callback on the WP 7.0 default_role_dropdown_excluded_roles filter that removes editor from the excluded-role list while preserving administrator. The runtime calls the function and applies the filter to the core default exclusions.
requirements: Use the default-role excluded roles filter
Register the filter inside the function

assertions.code: if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_roles_caps_006' ) ) { return false; } wpbp_roles_caps_006(); $excluded = apply_filters( 'default_role_dropdown_excluded_roles', array( 'administrator', 'editor' ) ); return in_array( 'administrator', $excluded, true ) && ! in_array( 'editor', $excluded, true );
assertions.description: The filter preserves Administrator exclusion while allowing Editor

tests.reference_solution: function wpbp_roles_caps_006(): void { add_filter( 'default_role_dropdown_excluded_roles', function ( array $excluded_roles ): array { return array_values( array_diff( $excluded_roles, array( 'editor' ) ) ); } ); }

tests.prompt: Implement a function that reports whether a specific user has the requested capability without changing the current user.
tests.expected_behavior: Reviewer contract: The function should check the supplied user's capability with user_can rather than switching global current-user state. The runtime verifies both a granted and denied capability for a Subscriber and checks that the current user is unchanged.
requirements: Use WordPress roles/capabilities APIs
Do not switch the current user

forbidden_patterns.description: Should not switch current-user state for a specific-user check

assertions.code: $user_id = $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_007_user_id'] ?? 0; if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_roles_caps_007' ) || ! is_int( $user_id ) ) { return false; } $before = get_current_user_id(); $ok = wpbp_roles_caps_007( $user_id, 'read' ) && ! wpbp_roles_caps_007( $user_id, 'manage_options' ); return $ok && get_current_user_id() === $before;
assertions.description: A specific Subscriber can read, cannot manage options, and current user is unchanged

runtime_checks.teardown: $user_id = $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_007_user_id'] ?? 0; if ( is_int( $user_id ) ) { require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/user.php'; wp_delete_user( $user_id ); } unset( $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_007_user_id'] );

tests.reference_solution: function wpbp_roles_caps_007( int $user_id, string $cap ): bool { return user_can( $user_id, $cap ); }

requirements: Use WordPress roles/capabilities APIs
Return the primitive capabilities from WordPress meta-cap mapping

runtime_checks.setup: $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_008_user_id'] = wp_insert_user( array( 'user_login' => 'wpbp_delete_cap_' . wp_rand(), 'user_pass' => wp_generate_password(), 'role' => 'author' ) ); if ( is_int( $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_008_user_id'] ) ) { $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_008_post_id'] = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_title' => 'WPBP owned published post', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_author' => $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_008_user_id'] ) ); }

assertions.code: $user_id = $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_008_user_id'] ?? 0; $post_id = $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_008_post_id'] ?? 0; if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_roles_caps_008' ) || ! is_int( $user_id ) || ! is_int( $post_id ) ) { return false; } $caps = wpbp_roles_caps_008( $user_id, $post_id ); return is_array( $caps ) && array_values( $caps ) === array( 'delete_published_posts' );

'wp-admin/includes/user.php'; wp_delete_user( $user_id ); } unset( $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_008_post_id'], $GLOBALS['wpbp_roles_caps_008_user_id'] );

tests.reference_solution: function wpbp_roles_caps_008( int $user_id, int $post_id ): array { return map_meta_cap( 'delete_post', $user_id, $post_id ); }

tests.prompt: Implement a function that returns the IDs of every user who holds a given capability, whether the capability comes from a role that includes it or was granted to the user individually. Users without the capability must not be returned.
tests.expected_behavior: The function runs a `WP_User_Query` with `capability__in` (or `capability`), which expands to the roles that include the capability and also matches capabilities stored directly on a user, so both a custom-role holder and an individually granted Subscriber are found. Runtime validation seeds a custom role holder, a directly granted user, a user holding a different custom capability, and a plain Subscriber, then queries two different capabilities and an unused one.
requirements: Return an array of user IDs (integers)
Match users whose role includes the capability and users the capability was added to directly
Return an empty array when nobody holds the capability

required_patterns.description: Queries users through the user query API
Queries by capability rather than by role name

runtime_checks.setup: add_role( 'wpbp_reviewer', 'WPBP Reviewer', array( 'read' => true, 'wpbp_moderate_reports' => true ) ); $role_user = wp_insert_user( array( 'user_login' => 'wpbp_rc_009_role', 'user_pass' => wp_generate_password(), 'user_email' => 'wpbp-rc-009-role@example.com', 'role' => 'wpbp_reviewer' ) ); $direct_user = wp_insert_user( array( 'user_login' => 'wpbp_rc_009_direct', 'user_pass' => wp_generate_password(), 'user_email' => 'wpbp-rc-009-direct@example.com', 'role' => 'subscriber' ) ); $publisher = wp_insert_user( array( 'user_login' => 'wpbp_rc_009_publisher', 'user_pass' => wp_generate_password(), 'user_email' => 'wpbp-rc-009-publisher@example.com', 'role' => 'subscriber' ) ); $plain = wp_insert_user( array( 'user_login' => 'wpbp_rc_009_plain', 'user_pass' => wp_generate_password(), 'user_email' => 'wpbp-rc-009-plain@example.com', 'role' => 'subscriber' ) ); $direct = new WP_User( (int) $direct_user ); $direct->add_cap( 'wpbp_moderate_reports' ); $pub = new WP_User( (int) $publisher ); $pub->add_cap( 'wpbp_publish_reports' ); $GLOBALS['wpbp_rc_009_users'] = array( 'role' => (int) $role_user, 'direct' => (int) $direct_user, 'publisher' => (int) $publisher, 'plain' => (int) $plain );

assertions.code: if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_roles_caps_009' ) ) { return false; } $users = (array) ( $GLOBALS['wpbp_rc_009_users'] ?? array() ); if ( 4 !== count( $users ) ) { return false; } $normalize = static function ( $value ) { if ( ! is_array( $value ) ) { return null; } $ids = array_map( 'intval', $value ); sort( $ids ); return $ids; }; $moderators = $normalize( wpbp_roles_caps_009( 'wpbp_moderate_reports' ) ); $expected = array( (int) $users['role'], (int) $users['direct'] ); sort( $expected ); if ( $moderators !== $expected ) { return false; } $publishers = $normalize( wpbp_roles_caps_009( 'wpbp_publish_reports' ) ); if ( $publishers !== array( (int) $users['publisher'] ) ) { return false; } return array() === $normalize( wpbp_roles_caps_009( 'wpbp_unused_capability' ) );
assertions.description: Role-derived and directly granted capability holders are found, and an unused capability returns nobody

runtime_checks.teardown: require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/user.php'; foreach ( (array) ( $GLOBALS['wpbp_rc_009_users'] ?? array() ) as $user_id ) { if ( (int) $user_id > 0 ) { wp_delete_user( (int) $user_id ); } } unset( $GLOBALS['wpbp_rc_009_users'] ); remove_role( 'wpbp_reviewer' );

tests.reference_solution: function wpbp_roles_caps_009( string $capability ): array { $query = new WP_User_Query( array( 'capability__in' => array( $capability ), 'fields' => 'ID', 'orderby' => 'ID', 'order' => 'ASC' ) ); return array_map( 'intval', (array) $query->get_results() ); }
exploit_solutions: function wpbp_roles_caps_009( string $capability ): array { $roles = wp_roles()->roles; $matching = array(); foreach ( $roles as $slug => $role ) { if ( ! empty( $role['capabilities'][ $capability ] ) ) { $matching[] = $slug; } } if ( ! $matching ) { return array(); } $query = new WP_User_Query( array( 'role__in' => $matching, 'fields' => 'ID' ) ); return array_map( 'intval', (array) $query->get_results() ); }

tests.prompt: A site delegates single reports to individual people: a report post of the 'wpbp_report' post type may name one user ID in its 'wpbp_delegate' post meta, and that user must be able to edit that one report. Write the code that grants this. The delegate must gain no general editing ability and no other permission on the report, other reports must stay closed to them, and every other user's permissions must be unchanged.
tests.expected_behavior: The code filters `map_meta_cap` (or `user_has_cap`) for the `edit_post` meta capability only, checks that the target post is a `wpbp_report` whose `wpbp_delegate` meta matches the user being tested, and returns a primitive the user already holds (for example `read`). Runtime validation checks the delegate can edit their report but not a second report, cannot `edit_posts`, cannot `delete_post` the delegated report, that another Subscriber cannot edit it, and that the administrator is unaffected.
requirements: Grant the edit capability only for the specific report whose 'wpbp_delegate' meta names the user
Do not grant any site-wide editing capability and do not change any other capability check
Leave the permissions of other users and other posts unchanged

required_patterns.description: Restricts the grant to the report post type

runtime_checks.setup: register_post_type( 'wpbp_report', array( 'label' => 'WPBP Reports', 'public' => true, 'capability_type' => 'post', 'map_meta_cap' => true, 'supports' => array( 'title', 'editor', 'custom-fields' ) ) ); $delegate = wp_insert_user( array( 'user_login' => 'wpbp_rc_010_delegate', 'user_pass' => wp_generate_password(), 'user_email' => 'wpbp-rc-010-delegate@example.com', 'role' => 'subscriber' ) ); $bystander = wp_insert_user( array( 'user_login' => 'wpbp_rc_010_bystander', 'user_pass' => wp_generate_password(), 'user_email' => 'wpbp-rc-010-bystander@example.com', 'role' => 'subscriber' ) ); $allowed = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => 'wpbp_report', 'post_title' => 'Delegated report', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_author' => 1 ) ); $closed = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => 'wpbp_report', 'post_title' => 'Closed report', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_author' => 1 ) ); update_post_meta( (int) $allowed, 'wpbp_delegate', (int) $delegate ); $GLOBALS['wpbp_rc_010'] = array( 'delegate' => (int) $delegate, 'bystander' => (int) $bystander, 'allowed' => (int) $allowed, 'closed' => (int) $closed );

assertions.code: $fixtures = (array) ( $GLOBALS['wpbp_rc_010'] ?? array() ); if ( 4 !== count( $fixtures ) ) { return false; } $delegate = get_userdata( (int) $fixtures['delegate'] ); $bystander = get_userdata( (int) $fixtures['bystander'] ); $admin = get_userdata( 1 ); if ( ! $delegate instanceof WP_User || ! $bystander instanceof WP_User || ! $admin instanceof WP_User ) { return false; } $allowed = (int) $fixtures['allowed']; $closed = (int) $fixtures['closed']; if ( ! user_can( $delegate, 'edit_post', $allowed ) ) { return false; } if ( user_can( $delegate, 'edit_post', $closed ) ) { return false; } if ( user_can( $delegate, 'edit_posts' ) || user_can( $delegate, 'edit_others_posts' ) ) { return false; } if ( user_can( $delegate, 'delete_post', $allowed ) || user_can( $delegate, 'publish_posts' ) ) { return false; } if ( user_can( $bystander, 'edit_post', $allowed ) ) { return false; } return user_can( $admin, 'edit_post', $allowed ) && user_can( $admin, 'edit_post', $closed );
assertions.description: Only the delegated user gains edit access, and only to their own report

runtime_checks.teardown: $fixtures = (array) ( $GLOBALS['wpbp_rc_010'] ?? array() ); require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/user.php'; foreach ( array( 'delegate', 'bystander' ) as $key ) { $user_id = (int) ( $fixtures[ $key ] ?? 0 ); if ( $user_id > 0 ) { wp_delete_user( $user_id ); } } foreach ( array( 'allowed', 'closed' ) as $key ) { $post_id = (int) ( $fixtures[ $key ] ?? 0 ); if ( $post_id > 0 ) { wp_delete_post( $post_id, true ); } } unset( $GLOBALS['wpbp_rc_010'] ); remove_all_filters( 'map_meta_cap' ); remove_all_filters( 'user_has_cap' ); unregister_post_type( 'wpbp_report' );

tests.reference_solution: add_filter( 'map_meta_cap', static function ( $caps, $cap, $user_id, $args ) { if ( 'edit_post' !== $cap || empty( $args[0] ) ) { return $caps; } $post = get_post( $args[0] ); if ( ! $post instanceof WP_Post || 'wpbp_report' !== $post->post_type ) { return $caps; } $delegate = (int) get_post_meta( $post->ID, 'wpbp_delegate', true ); if ( $delegate > 0 && $delegate === (int) $user_id ) { return array( 'read' ); } return $caps; }, 10, 4 );
exploit_solutions: add_filter( 'user_has_cap', static function ( $allcaps ) { $allcaps['edit_posts'] = true; $allcaps['edit_others_posts'] = true; $allcaps['edit_published_posts'] = true; return $allcaps; }, 10, 1 );

add_filter( 'map_meta_cap', static function ( $caps, $cap, $user_id, $args ) { if ( 'edit_post' !== $cap || empty( $args[0] ) ) { return $caps; } $post = get_post( $args[0] ); if ( $post instanceof WP_Post && 'wpbp_report' === $post->post_type ) { return array( 'read' ); } return $caps; }, 10, 4 );

add_filter( 'map_meta_cap', static function ( $caps, $cap, $user_id, $args ) { if ( empty( $args[0] ) ) { return $caps; } $post = get_post( $args[0] ); if ( ! $post instanceof WP_Post || 'wpbp_report' !== $post->post_type ) { return $caps; } $delegate = (int) get_post_meta( $post->ID, 'wpbp_delegate', true ); if ( $delegate > 0 && $delegate === (int) $user_id ) { return array( 'read' ); } return $caps; }, 10, 4 );
